name: Photopsia
source:
Photopsia is a tale of horror inspired by the phenomenon of, well, Photopsia, the stars you see when you get really dizzy. It's about Iris, and the strange adventures she experiences in her dreams.

[From [url=https://loutanina.itch.io/photopsia] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《幻影》是一个恐怖故事，灵感来自幻影现象，即当你感到头晕时看到的星星。这是关于艾里斯以及她在梦中经历的奇怪冒险的故事。

[来自[url=https://loutanina.itch.io/photopsia] itch.io[/url]]
